items.title: The Swordmaster's Son
items.description:
Jin Runcandel was destined to become the head of his swordmaster clan. But despite his best efforts, he's banished for his shoddy swordsmanship. Though Jin eventually makes a contract with the god Solderet and is freed from the curse that hindered his abilities, he meets a rather unfortunate end. In the next moment, however, he awakens as a baby, long before his tragedy began. Armed with a second chance and some new powers, Jin swears to fulfill his destiny and become the ultimate swordmaster.

(Source: Tapas)

items.title: The Academy's Genius Swordsman
items.description:
Following a momentous battle against giants for the fate of the world, Ronan emerges victorious as the last man standing of the imperial army. As he laments this hollow victory with his dying commander, Grand Marshal Adeshan, they quickly learn that the war is far from over and an overwhelming force of giants descends from the heavens. Fearing the worst, yet seeing hope in the courageous Ronan, Adeshan uses her last time slip to send him back to the past, so that he can enroll in the prestigious Phileon Academy and become the strongest swordsman the empire has ever seen!

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: The Legendary Hero is an Academy Honors Student
items.description:
In the Age of Catastrophe, five heroes saved the world from a primordial evil. One of the heroes, now reborn as Leo Plove, is excited to revisit his glorious past—only to find his name erased from history. Determined to uncover the truth, he joins Lumerne, a hero military academy, unaware he's about to discover dark secrets surrounding his reincarnation. Why are his past records hidden, and who wants to keep them that way? Will Leo be able to set things right and reclaim the credit he deserves?

(Source: Tapas)

items.title: Reincarnation of the Fist King
items.description:
Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he’s reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using his knowledge of martial arts from his past life and the wealth of his current life, he only has one goal: get stronger and kill those who killed him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Chronicles of the Lazy Sovereign
items.description:
The path to greatness begins… tomorrow! It’s always a day too early for a great procrastinator like Yeonho Wi to start training. So how did someone as lazy as him become a great warrior renowned for his virtue, benevolence, and might? Follow the historian’s journey to uncover the hidden secrets of the lazy master of martial arts.

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: There's No Such Thing as a Bad Lady
items.description:
Raised in the slums of Ebelstein, Derek knows all too well that magic cannot bridge social divides. Through harsh lessons and hard-earned discipline, he rises to become a second-tier mage, scraping by as a mercenary. Life takes a different turn when he is appointed as a magical tutor to Diella Duplain-- the temperamental youngest daughter of a noble house, unable to wield magic despite her lineage. Though Derek is her last resort before exile to a convent, Diella clashes with him from the start. Together, will they be able to prove that there’s no such thing as a “bad” lady?

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: The Legend of Enxue
items.description:
When his grandfather is suddenly brutally murdered by a member of the Demonic Martial Alliance, Fu Enxue vows that he will stop at nothing to avenge his death. To find the perpetrator, he infiltrates the alliance armed only with his wits and thirst for vengeance. There, he catches the attention of the demonic masters, as his overwhelming bloodlust makes him a prodigy in the demonic arts. But will this thirst for blood help him in his pursuit of revenge, or will that same power be his undoing?

(Source: Tapas)

items.title: Neoman Boindan Mariya
items.description:
Following the advice of his imaginary friend Jason, who told him, "Treat all girls like stones," Park Jin-yong starts seeing every girl as a stone. But then Sunwoo, a female student who doesn’t look like a stone, appears before him, and for the first time in five years, the sight of a girl’s face sends Jinyong’s happy little circuits into overdrive...

(Source: Naver, translated)

items.title: Dungeon-eul Geurineun Hwaga
items.description:
In a world forever changed by the Great Cataclysm that reshaped the entire globe... Seo Jio, an ordinary art teacher, dies in a sudden fire, only to awaken trapped inside a portrait as a painting himself. Within the world of the portrait, Jio gains omnipotent abilities. He can create life and even open gateways to other dimensions. As he travels across countless dimensions, Jio encounters people bound by fate and uses his newfound abilities to help them overcome the trials before them. But with every dimension he crosses and every incident he resolves, he draws closer to uncovering the truth shrouding his own death…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

items.title: Prologue-eseo 30-nyeoni Heulleotda
items.description:
I "transmigrated" into a world I'd never seen before. For thirty years, I believed I was living in a classic fantasy RPG. I became a war hero, retired, and thought I was finally about to see the ending. But... Those thirty years were only the prologue. It turns out the real story is about an academy?

(Source: Naver, translated)

items.title: The Martial Genius Who Remembers Everything
items.description:
So-un Jin, a third-rate martial artist with an exceptional memory, awakens 30 years in the past, just before the return of the Demonic Cult. He's been given a second chance, but that's where divine intervention ends. With no innate talent for martial arts, no legendary master to guide him, and only a small, powerless sect to call home, his future seems just as bleak as before. Can So-un use his knowledge of the future to change the course of fate?

(Source: WEBTOON)
